control_1907.xSQL:
UPDATE quota_top_down_grid_framework
SET adjusted_quota_ft =
    CASE
    WHEN :v_method ='Equal Split' THEN
            (SELECT SUM(adjusted_quota_ft)
             FROM quota_top_down_grid_framework 
             WHERE cities IS NULL) / select count(new_territory) from quota_top_down_grid_framework where new_territory like 'District %'
             WHEN :v_method = 'Manual Weighting' THEN
            (SELECT SUM(adjusted_quota_ft)
             FROM quota_top_down_grid_framework 
             WHERE cities IS NULL) * ratio
   
   ELSE 0
    END
WHERE
 cities=:var_parent

control_1902.xSQL:
UPDATE quota_top_down_grid_framework t_child
SET adjusted_quota_ft =
    CASE
        WHEN :v_method = 'Equal Split' THEN
            (SELECT adjusted_quota_ft FROM quota_top_down_grid_framework WHERE new_territory = :var_parent) /
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quota_top_down_grid_framework WHERE cities = :var_parent)

        WHEN :v_method = 'Manual Weighting' THEN
            (SELECT adjusted_quota_ft FROM quota_top_down_grid_framework WHERE new_territory = :var_parent) *
            (t_child.ratio / (SELECT SUM(ratio) FROM quota_top_down_grid_framework WHERE cities = :var_parent))

        ELSE adjusted_quota_ft
    END
WHERE
    t_child.cities = :var_parent

control_1918.xSQL:
UPDATE quota_top_down_grid_framework
SET adjusted_quota_ft =
    CASE
        WHEN
            :v_method != 'Weighted Last Year Quota' OR
            :v_method != 'Weighted Last Year Actuals' OR -- Corrected typographic quote
            :v_method != 'Weighted TAM' OR
            :v_method != 'Manual Weighting' OR
            :v_method != 'Equal Split'
        THEN
            (SELECT parent.adjusted_quota_ft
             FROM quota_top_down_grid_framework parent
             WHERE parent.new_territory = :var_parent
               AND parent.cities IS NULL
            ) * ratio 
        ELSE 0
    END
WHERE
    (cities = :var_parent)  
    ;

control_1956.xSQL:
UPDATE quota_top_down_new
SET ratio = 
    CASE 
        WHEN :v_method_new = 'Manual Weighting' THEN
            reference2 / 
            (SELECT reference2 
             FROM quota_top_down_new 
             WHERE 
                 territory = :v_parent_new
                 AND Model = :v_model_new
                 AND scenario = :v_scenario_new
             LIMIT 1)
        ELSE 0
    END
WHERE 
    Parent = :v_parent_new
    AND Model = :v_model_new
    AND scenario = :v_scenario_new;

control_2005.xSQL:
UPDATE quota_top_down_new t_child
SET adjusted_quota = 
    CASE
        WHEN :v_method_new = 'Equal Split' THEN
            (SELECT adjusted_quota 
             FROM quota_top_down_new 
             WHERE territory = :v_parent_new 
             AND scenario = :v_scenario_new 
             AND Model = :v_model_new
             LIMIT 1) /
            (SELECT COUNT(*) 
             FROM quota_top_down_new 
             WHERE parent = :v_parent_new 
             AND scenario = :v_scenario_new 
             AND Model = :v_model_new)
        
        WHEN :v_method_new = 'Manual Weighting' THEN
            (SELECT adjusted_quota 
             FROM quota_top_down_new 
             WHERE territory = :v_parent_new 
             AND scenario = :v_scenario_new 
             AND Model = :v_model_new
             LIMIT 1) * t_child.ratio

        ELSE t_child.adjusted_quota
    END
WHERE
    t_child.parent = :v_parent_new 
    AND t_child.scenario = :v_scenario_new 
    AND t_child.Model = :v_model_new;
